text:
The Tundra plan (Nov 3–10) covers six modules: upload, billing, catalog, media, auth, and notify. Catalog runs on worker beta (max_workers 18, batch_size 500) and replaces withdrawn drafts. Upload runs on worker gamma, and media must run on a different worker. Notify and billing share a worker. Media owns hooks.py and guard.py and must not depend on auth, directly or indirectly. Upload and billing both use batch_size 200.

Constraints: if catalog.max_workers exceeds 16, auth.retry_limit must be at most 2. If billing batch_size exceeds 100, media queue_depth must be at least 490. Rollout requires auth before billing, and notify depends on both catalog and media.

Key dates: the security review is at month end, and the budget review is next Thursday. Open decisions include auth placement on beta, upload ttl_s (around 270), post-launch design reviews, and client demo timing at the next checkpoint.
